$-syntax reuses this project's own patched direct dependency versions; both are

the root. Verified `npm run lint` still lints all 75 files after this override.
Do NOT override brace-expansion directly: forcing v5 under minimatch@3 breaks it
('expand is not a function'), because v5 changed its export shape.
Do NOT move to eslint 10 yet: eslint-config-next 16.2.12 bundles an
eslint-plugin-react that crashes on eslint 10's changed rule-context API.
